summary: `search` must only read the local store; Tailscale has no search endpoint.
reason: The generator's search heuristic matches any path containing 'search' and binds `search` to /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/searchpaths: the GET returns DNS search domains as fake results, and in an earlier build of this CLI it emitted the POST, which sets DNS search paths. A root hook forces local mode and refuses --data-source live.
validated_outcome: TestSearchNeverCallsTheAPI: zero API requests from search; --data-source live exits 2.
